laws.summary: GPT Web uses one Session Controller to bind task identity, semantic execution profile, exact conversation topology, bounded page actions and compulsory privacy-safe title finalization without making titles a routing identity.

clauses.statement: GPT Web feeds must use one bounded Session Controller with canonical conversation identity, semantic execution-profile proof and compulsory privacy-safe title finalization without making the title an identity authority.

required: Every governed GPT feed resolves exactly one topology mode: fresh, same_conversation or forked_from_checkpoint. A checkpoint fork first verifies the exact parent canonical URL, parent user-turn marker and following assistant response hash, performs the provider branch action, proves a distinct child canonical URL with inherited checkpoint history, and records action evidence plus child history fingerprint before child submission. Unsupported or ambiguous fork controls fail closed and never degrade to a blank chat or uploaded summary.

Runtime capacity is operator-owned, positive, bounded and configurable without becoming a caller field or product-mode switch; the default capacity supports at least ten independent in-flight GPT conversations. Browser mutations remain globally serialized while provider generation waits do not hold the mutation lease.

Every feed owns structured taskIdentity, immutable input hash, opaque execution/attempt identity, deterministic logical-turn marker and submitted-prompt hash. Retries for the same semantic turn retain the marker; changed input receives another marker. Callers never control concurrency, title, tab id, marker, selector, coordinate, browser command or action plan.

Durable provider identity is exactly canonical non-WEB /c/ URL plus unique logical-turn marker and, after capture, response hash. A transient /c/WEB: URL is anti-resubmission evidence only. A human-readable provider title is secondary operator evidence only and must never authorize routing, continuation, fork, retry, recovery, deduplication or response capture.

Every production GPT feed carries one canonical gpt-web-execution-profile.v1 before input hashing. The profile binds profileRef/profileHash, provider, transport, account capability, exact model display name/family, semantic reasoning tier, executor identity, acceptance identity and optional source profile identity. Semantic reasoning tiers are medium, high, extra_high, pro_standard and pro_extended. Legacy xhigh/pro vocabulary is normalized before hashing; a fixed slider index, coordinate-derived reasoning level, silent model substitution or reasoning downgrade is forbidden.

Before attachments or prompt submission, Session Controller observes the current exact provider page and enforces the requested profile. If the already selected model and reasoning tier are exact it emits no-op proof; otherwise it selects exactly one semantic model candidate and exactly one semantic reasoning candidate and then reads both back. Missing or multiple candidates, wrong provider page, document drift, unavailable account capability or read-back mismatch fail closed. The verified profile proof is persisted in the execution ledger and projected into providerProof.

A fresh GPT execution is established only on the provider root with zero user turns, zero assistant turns, empty composer, no staged attachment, no pasted-text card and no active generation. If that exact clean state already exists no New chat click occurs; otherwise only the unique actionable data-testid=create-new-chat-button sidebar anchor resolving to provider root is allowed. Unknown user drafts are never cleared. A stale GrassEye root draft may be cleared only when one exact marker resolves to one different durable canonical submitted execution and all zero-state guards are atomically rechecked immediately before mutation.

A continuation first focuses its exact parent canonical URL and, when available, verifies the parent turn marker before upload or send. A checkpoint fork verifies its parent marker and checkpoint response before branching. A send click is not submission success: success requires one exact marked user turn, canonical non-WEB conversation identity and no conflicting execution binding. Page-global turn counts are observational only and cannot authorize retries.

Response capture is scoped to the unique marked user turn and the immediately following substantive assistant turn. The governed outer turn identity is [data-testid^=conversation-turn-][data-turn=user|assistant]. Legacy article/data-message-author-role selectors, page-global last assistant selection and model-marker echo are forbidden as second identity chains. Loading, shimmer, reasoning, research progress, citation verification and tool summaries are not completed answers.

When expectedOutputKind is generated_image, Gateway binds the exact marked user turn to the immediately following assistant turn, waits for exactly one completed generated-image card, opens that exact HTMLElement role=button card, uses exactly one visible button[aria-label=保存] viewer action and registers one newly downloaded decodable image with original byte hash and opaque provider output ref. Screenshots, other page images, 下载/Download text fallbacks, native-button casting and more than one new download are forbidden.

Immediately after a text assistant turn is complete, runtime atomically persists answer bytes, hash, byte count, capture time and provider page URL as the response checkpoint before title finalization, artifact projection or cleanup. A generated-image output records its immutable output hash before title finalization. The checkpoint protects provider-result truth and prevents resubmission, but for a title-managed production GPT execution it is not by itself publishable success.

Every new fresh conversation and every provider-created fork child is title-managed. Its expected title is generated only from allowlisted task label/role mappings, persisted creation time in operator time zone Asia/Dubai and an opaque short execution trace. It must not contain prompt text, user name, birth data, phone, email, address, sourceTaskId, database key, file name, turn marker, report content or another free-text user field. The caller cannot provide the title.

After the result checkpoint and canonical submission proof exist, Session Controller performs one bounded title-finalization transaction under the existing exclusive patrol lease: focus exact canonical URL plus unique marker, locate the exact canonical sidebar row, reveal only that row's options, choose exactly one Rename action, locate one title textbox, write the expected title, read it back before commit, commit, then prove canonical path, unique marker and exact title. Already-correct title is a no-op proof. The transaction records page-action evidence and a verified conversationTitleProof. It never creates a title-housekeeping worker or a second title-routing chain.

same_conversation continuation does not invent a new title. If the parent carries a verified title proof, the continuation inherits the exact expected title/hash and repairs drift during finalization; if a legacy parent predates this protocol and has no title proof, the continuation remains legacy-unmanaged and no fake title success is minted. Fork children receive a new title because they are distinct provider conversations.

A title-managed execution may publish final success only after providerExecutionProfileProof and conversationTitleProof both match the immutable request/execution identity. Temporary rename-menu, textbox, sidebar-materialization, search-result or document-generation instability is recovery_pending and retains the response checkpoint, execution id, marker and provider lease evidence. Ambiguous or wrong-target controls are review_required. No title failure may erase the checkpoint or cause the provider turn to be resubmitted.

GPT Web page actions are governed as one action-state contract. Each committed mutation may append bounded evidence containing action id, execution id, exact target/document reference hashes, before/after URL, candidate count, semantic labels, result and evidence hash. A BrowserDocumentRef change invalidates old coordinates and observations; the action must restart observation on the same execution rather than reusing stale coordinates.

Existing conversation routing first uses exact canonical pathname in the one physical tab and verifies the unique marker after the click. When the exact older sidebar row is not materially available, chat search is a bounded discovery fallback: search uses the exact turn marker, a result is accepted only if its href resolves to the already persisted canonical pathname, and after click canonical pathname plus unique marker are re-proved. Search title matching may never become identity authority. Every search exit closes and verifies the exact Search chats dialog.

Submitted feeds release the browser-mutation lease before provider generation completes. Admitted submissions retain priority over ordinary response patrol; submission and patrol waiters use one durable SQLite ticket ledger with strict FIFO patrol admission after submissions drain. Rate-limit acknowledgement remains the highest-priority process-wide survival action and never refreshes the page.

Every page operation binds to the internally held exact ChatGPT BrowserTargetRef and current BrowserDocumentRef through the authenticated extension transport. After process restart, a submitted execution may reacquire only its exact persisted canonical URL: one exact-URL tab binds, multiple exact-URL tabs is identity ambiguity, absent exact URL opens that URL, unrelated same-origin tabs are ignored. After binding, normal conversation switching is sidebar DOM routing, not URL-first navigation.

Every execution failure appends a bounded durable ledger entry with occurrence time, attempt id, pre-failure phase, classification, recoverability and reason. Temporary provider unavailability, capacity, rate limiting, browser disconnection, temporarily absent canonical row, page hydration, profile-menu not ready, title UI not ready and bounded search discovery are recovery_pending. Login/captcha/2FA/security barriers or ambiguous identity require review_required. Immutable profile/input/hash mismatch is failed.

Process recovery never resubmits a captured provider turn. A valid checkpoint is loaded before browser reacquisition; for title-managed production GPT, recovery continues profile/title finalization on the exact canonical URL and marker before publication. Without a checkpoint, recovery trusts only persisted input identity, ordered attachment proof, canonical conversation identity and marker, never the caller's disposable source path. Legacy v2 execution records are migrated to v3 without fabricating providerExecutionProfileProof or conversationTitleProof.

When an authorized factory supersedes one proven polluted pre-submit execution, ownership transfer is explicit and atomic. A corrected runtime may recover the same unsubmitted execution; retry count and failure-ledger length never convert recoverable provider lookup into a terminal user block.

There is exactly one live GPT page-control chain: web-chat-shared -> web-chat-session-controller -> semantic profile / canonical routing / title finalization actions. The retired web-chat-model-identity, web-chat-chat-title, system-title, named-title search, rename patrol and title-housekeeping implementations remain physically deleted.

laws.summary: The factory executes the user-result products, private-base actions and four explicit single-stage localization products through fixed graphs and provider-verified checkpoint topology.

clauses.statement: Private bases execute once per stable identity; every formal child has one explicit provider topology proof and typed joins never merge conversations or invent a synthetic subject.

A real signed-in Chrome run and its persisted provider records must prove the production conversation topology, attachment counts, unique response markers and exact continuation or fork relationships.

required: The protocol includes four single-stage localization products: localization_report_translation, localization_article_translation, localization_static_review_candidate and localization_static_review_selector.

Localization static-review candidate roles candidate_a and candidate_b are independent single-stage jobs; selector_first, selector_swap and consistency are single-stage selector jobs, with selector_swap continuing the exact selector conversation through conversation_parent.

Localization products have no person subject or synthetic participant; they bind only the immutable localization review context ref/hash, conversation scope and lease. User and chart products continue to require real frozen participants.

A localization stage may complete only with persisted provider transcript JSONL plus hash and live model identity evidence (family, display name, reasoning effort and evidence hash); request metadata alone is never model proof.

GPT Web localization execution must use the visible composer capability control to open the model menu, visibly select GPT-5.6 Sol, then select and read back the reasoning label from the live slider mapping: 0=极速, 1=中, 2=高, 3=极高, 4=Pro; the requested stage profile is not proof until the provider UI read-back matches.

Provider UI observation must be limited to visible semantic roles/labels (model menu item, reasoning slider and live page URL); missing, ambiguous or mismatched controls fail closed as review_required before prompt submission, and no request field or hardcoded profile may substitute for the observation.
Only versioned product profiles control dependencies, typed joins, conversation topology and final stage.
BZ05, BZ03 and NM01 begin in distinct provider-verified children forked from one immutable Bazi base checkpoint; no child reuses the base or a sibling conversation.
NM01 naming_author continues its own question_analysis child, NM02 uses a fresh conversation distinct from its source report, and BZ04 continues the selected BZ05 or BZ03 formal parent conversation.
Hehun party A and party B private bases are isolated and final compatibility uses a third fresh context receiving only the typed participant manifest and verified private-base artifacts.
One target plus any auxiliaries keep one isolated base per person; the author receives only exact participant slots, roles, person/profile/chart identities, hashes and authorization proof.
Business plugins call AI Input Gateway only through its public contract.
Every stage binds the immutable input bundle as a non-file input ref, including zero-attachment stages.
Every provider result records one explicit fresh, same_conversation or forked_from_checkpoint proof; an unsupported or unproved exact fork fails closed.

Bazi, Qimen and Hehun paid follow-ups bind their fixed parent product, final stage, execution, scope and raw output hash; if the exact GPT Web URL is unavailable, the Agent replays the minimum necessary parent graph and continues only when the rebuilt raw hash is identical.
forbidden: website-controlled next action, browser command or per-stage cloud job
generic planner, AI-generated workflow or second execution owner
deterministic products entering GPT transport
duplicate canonical-base production for one stable identity
user question, partner or naming requirement included in a canonical-base identity
reuse of a user answer
a checkpoint child simulated with a blank chat, base summary, uploaded base transcript, second-model retelling or mutable base tail
a downstream same-conversation stage opening a blank or different GPT conversation
paid follow-up execution outside its exact or fully rebuilt parent conversation
blank new GPT conversation used as a follow-up fallback

laws.summary: Every production order and stage is idempotent, SQLite-durable and restart-recoverable; all work sharing one exact GPT URL uses one durable FIFO lane while different URLs remain concurrent.

clauses.statement: All work sharing one exact or reconstructed GPT URL executes through one durable FIFO lane; captured work survives restart, invalid outputs restart only their execution, and ordinary recovery never becomes a user-visible terminal failure.

required: Order, stage, raw response, provider proof and event truth persist in SQLite.
Every raw response hash uses canonical sha256-prefixed identity and byte-verified metadata repair preserves already completed analysis.
The default production window is ten and cloud claims subtract active local work.
A recoverable stage retries with bounded backoff under the live heartbeating lease so independent graph branches complete their required submissions before order-level deferral.

Restart resumes a durable submitted turn without duplicate prompt submission. Recoverable transport faults retain the same execution id and logical-turn marker, whether they happen before or after submission. Only a proven polluted or invalid completed answer, or a genuinely terminal pre-submit identity fault, creates a fresh execution id and fresh marker; a captured submission always resumes instead of sending again.
Restart reconciliation reclaims the original cloud job before local execution and republishes any already completed local result under a fresh lease.
A cloud-confirmed foreign-device recovery ledger is durably quarantined as review_required once and is excluded from later automatic restart reconciliation.
Only one order or stage for the same exact webChatUrl may submit at a time, in createdAt and orderId FIFO order.
Fork siblings use different conversation scopes and provider URLs, may execute in parallel within bounded capacity, and never share a same-conversation FIFO lane.

Restart, disconnect, lease takeover and disaster rebuild preserve frozen subject, participant manifest, parent checkpoint, child scope and provider proof; downstream stays blocked when a rebuilt parent raw hash differs.

Historical paid follow-ups without a continuation parent remain recovery_pending until the website reissues their immutable parent identity; an exact one-way local repair preserves old stage evidence and users never receive an ordinary runtime failure.

Provider citation residue, private-use characters, invalid required JSON and missing raw output are discarded and restarted with a fresh execution id and fresh marker, while a transport retry never duplicates one already submitted logical turn merely because page-global turn counts changed during provider hydration.

A failed or review_required gateway execution with durable submission proof always resumes the same execution id, marker and provider conversation. A fresh execution is allowed only for a proven polluted or invalid completed answer, or a genuinely terminal pre-submit identity fault.

A failed or review_required attachment upload proof is terminal for that attachment execution: same-lease loops, restart recovery and new leases preserve its proof and never call the Gateway upload again without explicit operator authorization.
A missing local or provider parent conversation is reconstructed from the lease-bound parent replay package and persisted in production_parent_conversation_rebuilds.
forbidden: in-memory-only order truth, untracked background promise or swallowed failure
unbounded cloud claiming, duplicate local execution or duplicate prompt submission
user-visible terminal loss for provider absence, output contamination or recoverable parent-conversation loss
detached local restart execution without an attached cloud publisher
re-querying the same cloud-confirmed foreign-device ledger on every restart
parallel submissions into one parent GPT conversation
using page-global user-turn count deltas as authority to resend a stage that already has an exact logical-turn marker
resuming a known detached downstream stage in its blank or wrong conversation
reviving an invalid parentless follow-up through a blank conversation
any second upload attempt after a terminal attachment upload proof
publishing provider-internal citation residue as a production answer

clauses.statement: The local factory activates through authenticated outbound lease polling and returns exact whole-order checkpoints, results and failures.

required: Device credentials remain local and permission-restricted.
Input download and every mutation bind the exact lease token and lease version.
The worker claims only available local production capacity.
Durable local orders are reconciled to the original cloud job before execution resumes; completed local results are republished under a fresh lease.

Every claimed conversation child includes a lease-bound continuation_parent_replay package plus exact frozen subject, conversation scope and typed join identities so a lost local parent can be reconstructed from its first stage.

unleased input download or result mutation
secret output in logs, routes or evidence
